name: Robyn De Vries
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: Robyn deVries and the Melbourne Art Therapy Studio are dedicated to providing people with the opportunity to discover their creative potential through art therapy and to enhance their mental health and well-being. Established in 2005 at the Abbotsford Convent in Melbourne, the studio offers a unique model of high-quality art therapy services to the community. The services provided by our professionally registered art therapists include individual sessions, group therapy, workshops, and team building activities.

name: Sanjay Lavoipierre
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Sanjay specialises in the areas of: Children and young people Grief and loss LGBTQIA+ Buddhist psychology Relationships and couples Breathwork Mindfulness and meditation Sanjay is a counsellor who offers a calm, grounded space where clients of all ages feel safe, supported and understood. He works with children and young people around issues like anxiety, confidence, emotional regulation and focus — always meeting them with patience, creativity and care. Sanjay also supports adults, with a particular focus on LGBTQIA+ clients and those exploring identity, life transitions, or the impact of cultural and spiritual experiences.
